values.note: 24 South sites reservable for peak season (two weeks before Memorial Day to the week after Labor Day; May 11 - Sept 14 in 2026), at least 5 days before arrival; an unreserved reservable site may be used as a walk-in. All other sites, and every site off-season, are first come, first served by self-registration envelope. In that peak window: 14 nights, then 3 days away (a move to Siems Park or Burt Lake resets it); no limit off-season. North seasonal sites are drawn by lottery in March; sites left over are first come. Check-in after 4 pm, check-out by 3 pm.

note: Kossuth County Conservation Board park on Smith Lake, 3 mi north of Algona on Hwy 169, with two campgrounds: South, along the south shore and the entry road (sites by the playground and swim beach, a cul-de-sac loop at the west end, an enclosed shelter), and North, two small full-hookup loops on the east-shore point by the boat ramp and open shelter. 1.5-mile lakeshore trail, the Water's Edge Nature Center, fishing docks, bird blind. --Claude
summary: Kossuth County pages and 2026 rules read: two campgrounds (South 47 W/E sites $20, North 15 FHU sites $25/$600 month/$2,250 seasonal lottery); count 49 -> 62, max rig 71; 50/30/20 amp; peak-season reservations (24 South sites, 5 days ahead, 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimums, 14 nights then 3 days away); season Apr 15 - Oct 31. Pin is in the lake.
flags: PIN IN THE LAKE: stored 43.12260,-94.23980 falls on open water in the south half of Smith Lake. Suggest the South Campground (47 of the 62 sites), about 43.1225,-94.2431 near the enclosed shelter between the cul-de-sac and the site rows.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (lakefront holds only on North 61-64): Smith Lake is ~500 x 300 m (well over 5 acres). The county's North map shows sites 61-64 on the west side of the loop, backing to the lake with only their own lawn (tables, fire rings) and a rock shore ~15-25 m beyond, no road between: on-water candidates. But North's 15 sites go first to a March seasonal lottery ($2,250 May-Oct) and only leftovers are sold first come, so those four may rarely be open by the night. South: sites 1-22 face the entry road, the playground and the swim beach (day use) and are not on the water; the county's pages say 43, 44, 47 and 48 in the west cul-de-sac have 'a nice view of the lake' (official lakeview, 4 candidates; imagery puts them ~40-50 m back behind a tree/brush fringe). If North's leftovers don't count, the entry is lakeview.
STORED NOTE HAD THE LOOPS REVERSED: it said the south loop was full hookup and the north water/electric; the county says North has full hookups (sewer) and South has water/electric only.

SEASONAL (informational, county park): North Campground's sites are offered first as May-October seasonals by lottery and also at $600/30 days; South is a nightly campground. Not a criteria issue for a public park.
SPLIT: North and South are ~400 m apart on different shores, under the ~1 km line; kept as one entry.
